definitions.explanation: A written account of a person's life, typically focusing on their achievements, character, and historical significance.

examples.english: I like reading biographies of great people.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝記|でんき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出版|しゅっぱん}→出版：03222_shuppan⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
{伝記|でんき}⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{賞|しょう}→賞：03227_shou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: The biographical film won an award.
